players.label: WR priority
players.reason: Ladd McConkey is available as a free agent and cleared the Week 8 injury report. Consider upgrading bench WR depth before adding another defense.

players.label: RB depth
players.reason: Jonah Coleman is available as a free agent. Consider him if RB depth is the priority; avoid dropping another scarce RB simply to add him.

rosterMove: Vikings are the spare-defense roster spot, but they remain in the Warren/Odunze offer for Amon-Ra St. Brown and Dameon Pierce. Resolve that offer before using the spot. McConkey and Coleman are free agents, not Wednesday-only waiver claims.
